shortDescription: Brazilian steelmaker Gerdau BMFBOVESPA:GGBR3 reported on Monday an adjusted net profit of 1.52 billion reais ($281.1 million) for the third quarter, up 39.7% from a year earlier, but missing market estimates.($1 = 5.4081 reais)
